title: Pick the default and the fallback
heading: Name a Default, a Fallback, and What Would Change the Decision
cases: of two finalists, the one with the lower seed spread is the default and the other the fallback
a solver that left a run unsolved is out, however low its spread
a solver whose runs did not repeat is out
a solver with strong evidence that failed a requirement is not picked
equal spreads are broken by name, whatever order the candidates come in
a solver that passed the requirements but has no evidence is not a finalist
